verdict.rationale: IDE integration is a fair axis for a coding agent, but nothing in the evidence mentions a JetBrains plugin, interactive diffs inside an IDE, or sharing selected code from an editor. The only related item is that Grok can run as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC for use in 'other apps'. That is a protocol building block, not a documented JetBrains integration, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
